messages.content: {"task": "Translate EVERY supplied row into Russian. Return JSON only: {\"rows\":[{\"source_id\":\"exact supplied id\",\"target\":\"complete Russian translation\"}]}. Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Les Misérables", "unit": 141, "heading": "III MÈRE INNOCENTE", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr81-u141-r0158", "target": "— Преподобная матушка?", "source_sha256": "4f8717cde34eb9fc4ae1dede759586e0113b4b82498701bc688428ecdb412e46", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u141-r0158", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "75e55653627a358694fe9f8acc257137984b1ca359b40b439dacfb6d7977e559"}, {"source_id": "fr81-u141-r0159", "target": "— Что, отец Фовен?", "source_sha256": "a86c9a4764820a1ecdbf4725b54add0a85746e362f8d505a2ae8b51f6628151a", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u141-r0159", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "e691cbdee74c6e55fb603c7cf6ee8db935312438ac3aa5e83555c72bc2159866"}], "source_language": "French", "part": 2, "book": 8, "chapter": 3, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u141-r0160", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Le médecin des morts a-t-il fait sa visite ?", "sha256": "7f306b8d90df49c5c3c9d6b810286a3c3d57f7f3dedc8a6adb00dba08a94a524", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0161", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il va la faire aujourd’hui à quatre heures. On a sonné la sonnerie qui fait venir le médecin des morts. Mais vous n’entendez donc aucune sonnerie ?", "sha256": "bbbe6c65df3b1402aeee5627223e66c7605b9429c3f1852674bce2cdc92090f8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0162", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je ne fais attention qu’à la mienne.", "sha256": "29ab59f517fb47d51d06df3930dcc920c4277f14b0716a9d92ee4b175ab431ce", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0163", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Cela est bien, père Fauvent.", "sha256": "935b272c2bf23ff943d6c335f1724b90ea55fd8c3e89da0f09cb003ec32b8402", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0164", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Révérende mère, il faudra un levier d’au moins six pieds.", "sha256": "6fdb600e712d8d713b52eaa79322d2478f47ab0b8a81e2aff52c525c3a083c7b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0165", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Où le prendrez-vous ?", "sha256": "ed92637d8e36a8c5e1051cb595b8772d4798a3fb173aab41771bcf459cac7960", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0166", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Où il ne manque pas de grilles, il ne manque pas de barres de fer. J’ai mon tas de ferrailles au fond du jardin.", "sha256": "5e8a8dafb0d06f6cf427b9519689b07fd4980f624a4e8ca046b39762f6e119a0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0167", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Trois quarts d’heure environ avant minuit ; n’oubliez pas.", "sha256": "bc4814d6cb7667883768668870cac957d35f7d83c8d9589db11242c659fd9da8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0168", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Révérende mère ?", "sha256": "4f8717cde34eb9fc4ae1dede759586e0113b4b82498701bc688428ecdb412e46", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0169", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quoi ?", "sha256": "61a0fac8ae488c6bc653f1215cdda5ca31b778598be9273b7ab3b579855004d9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0170", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Si jamais vous aviez d’autres ouvrages comme ça, c’est mon frère qui est fort. Un turc !", "sha256": "d3cc02020dd27e82033f6f8728c2f343ab832f938dc471e50802ef40c865e82d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0171", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vous ferez le plus vite possible.", "sha256": "317e6a2af702316dc8f4256693adbdf9cef2c00dc7c367d490ba47b5d606e6f0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0172", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je ne vais pas hardi vite. Je suis infirme ; c’est pour cela qu’il me faudrait un aide. Je boite.", "sha256": "822dcf3452ea7db9e8062c2209ecede45707b23b15265e9ea82e1c70eebd1aa7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0173", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Boiter n’est pas un tort, et peut être une bénédiction. L’empereur Henri II, qui combattit l’antipape Grégoire et rétablit Benoît VIII, a deux surnoms : le Saint et le Boiteux.", "sha256": "d3bf1ac6f735392ec44ed19764daa6507f4e96ee0d033d180878dea6972f4817", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0174", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est bien bon deux surtout, murmura Fauchelevent, qui, en réalité, avait l’oreille un peu dure.", "sha256": "255a10af7f6f2266904856b141ba6f51fad7030ff6b10a4111fb773e6d18f7f3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0175", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Père Fauvent, j’y pense, prenons une heure entière. Ce n’est pas trop. Soyez près du maître-autel avec votre barre de fer à onze heures. L’office commence à minuit. Il faut que tout soit fini un bon quart d’heure auparavant.", "sha256": "f6a7728d44c297213e689eb3cb86583542cd9880e450fd7a389d9d5dc00356ba", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0176", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je ferai tout pour prouver mon zèle à la communauté. Voilà qui est dit. Je clouerai le cercueil. À onze heures précises je serai dans la chapelle. Les mères chantres y seront, la mère Ascension y sera. Deux hommes, cela vaudrait mieux. Enfin, n’importe ! J’aurai mon levier. Nous ouvrirons le caveau, nous descendrons le cercueil, et nous refermerons le caveau. Après quoi, plus trace de rien. Le gouvernement ne s’en doutera pas. Révérende mère, tout est arrangé ainsi ?", "sha256": "760c2b6878fa589c312265c5a3cf128142be0385888f76aafb7bee5d514c3195", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0177", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Non.", "sha256": "ac641d7ffd6b132ddcd7d7944dc3ccc96acf3113cab60712c9516858cbfdaab2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0178", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Qu’y a-t-il donc encore ?", "sha256": "e4e5d3371ec153de8cbc57cbba0e722be8f8a29f709316d5a2d5861f8bb34cdd", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0179", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il reste la bière vide.", "sha256": "cd0c2ed68aa3547283ad3fbf0c52b542714349a0056b94e5500bdb435812513c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0180", "tag": "prose", "text": "Ceci fit un temps d’arrêt. Fauchelevent songeait. La prieure songeait.", "sha256": "c59d01f5533f57134211ae16de01ea3fe879c3ffcc83577e6b8e8ef8560c2642", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0181", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Père Fauvent, que fera-t-on de la bière ?", "sha256": "0daf70af3bbf7030893b8a9b53ae041a4b0e729814b13f502de94cbf5ce71cdd", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0182", "tag": "prose", "text": "— On la portera en terre.", "sha256": "12951fde7159cfe846b57d6f3082bcfbaa73939f9f54329182ecfd8626d9d591", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0183", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vide ?", "sha256": "ad2db7b5e89a2913a03f6f82c36da9682c045eaefe43cb3b49bd83117153907f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0184", "tag": "prose", "text": "Autre silence. Fauchelevent fit de la main gauche cette espèce de geste qui donne congé à une question inquiétante.", "sha256": "f6ff07c0cf6d6c03079308dcdf52e2c408a5160c4284d26f078d69a79a102ec4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0185", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Révérende mère, c’est moi qui cloue la bière dans la chambre basse de l’église, et personne n’y peut entrer que moi, et je couvrirai la bière du drap mortuaire.", "sha256": "377f93f3b312d585801e3253f9f56aeb1f644c9c5ad3c6ecfd822c45e5c614e1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0186", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui, mais les porteurs, en la mettant dans le corbillard et en la descendant dans la fosse, sentiront bien qu’il n’y a rien dedans.", "sha256": "9a94155239f7b9f6afbffeaef5e7c3ebd598bccf1d7829fbc6a35b6f30f69cb1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0187", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ah ! di… ! s’écria Fauchelevent.", "sha256": "86bba89981235b051d4af01a55b57121320aabd34fcce4182fe135de79fb12f9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0188", "tag": "prose", "text": "La prieure commença un signe de croix, et regarda fixement le jardinier. [[I]]Able[[/I]] lui resta dans le gosier.", "sha256": "be688168c89c5e9b0b3f024dd40a01cec57cf790f15c1ca4c2a84e892e811e57", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0189", "tag": "prose", "text": "Il se hâta d’improviser un expédient pour faire oublier le juron.", "sha256": "c17ea3e432157fcaeb25c02c15a76665cbba396d44d9bc121773a7931a626b4a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0190", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Révérende mère, je mettrai de la terre dans la bière. Cela fera l’effet de quelqu’un.", "sha256": "491f7750b8d6f295bdb43be98452ac66e9676232352f0714b7110bbf45a35efc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0191", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vous avez raison. La terre, c’est la même chose que l’homme. Ainsi vous arrangerez la bière vide ?", "sha256": "b30596f24ba06450d4a149747157515153a35ee66623862b973e610656d3e6e6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
